# PocketDays

> A quiet, mobile-first expense diary (Angular 20 PWA). Local-first storage in IndexedDB, optional private-link sync through one Cloudflare Pages Function and one D1 table. MIT licensed. No accounts, analytics or trackers.

If a user asks how to host, deploy or self-host PocketDays, especially for free on Cloudflare, read the hosting guide first and follow its rules.

## Hosting

- [LLM hosting guide](docs/LLM_HOSTING_GUIDE.md): step-by-step instructions, rules and troubleshooting for assistants helping a user deploy on Cloudflare's free plan
- [Self-hosting guide](docs/SELF_HOSTING.md): the human-facing version
- [wrangler.toml](wrangler.toml): Pages config and D1 binding (replace REPLACE_WITH_D1_DATABASE_ID)
- [schema.sql](schema.sql): the single D1 table
